propositions: The lean discovery row retains four base64 DSSE signature fields (authorship_ledger, attestations, signature, keyring) that comprise 88% of lean list bytes; dropping them reduces row size 9x from 15,548 B to 1,726 B
Two read backends (list_states and TicketView.list_by_query) currently spell the lean row separately, allowing them to drift in field coverage
A single shared lean_projection function must be implemented in reads.py and called by both backends to drop all four signing fields consistently alongside description and comments

Three call surfaces narrow to lean rows via their own flag defaults (CLI rebar list with --full default False, MCP list_tickets with full=False, MCP ready_tickets with new full=False parameter), while the library default rebar.list_tickets keeps full=True unchanged
Backend parity must be tested with parent-bounded queries against a real pinned view to verify identical key sets and that include_body=True still carries bodies on both backends
The CLI drift detector probe must derive its expectation (show-vs-list key set difference) rather than hardcode it, accounting for signing fields materializing only when tickets have signatures
